To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the obsidian artifacts from Tikal were made from six sources in central Mexico, the Guatemalan Highlands, and the Motagua Valley; 2) the sources of obsidian from Tikal can be correlated with artifact type and archaeological contexts; and 3) the sources utilized by the ancient Maya at Tikal changed through time.
